            rec.record_type = "FORENSIC_RECORD"
        else:
            rec.record_type = "UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN"
        return

    # default body
    rec.record_type = "UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN"
    rec.parser_confidence = "UNKNOWN"
    rec.classification_method = "STRUCTURAL"

    if "PERSISTENCE_LOCATION=~/Desktop/" in span_text:
        rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"
        rec.record_type = "HISTORICAL_PATH_STRING"

    classes_found: list[str] = []
    if re.search(r"^#{1,6} INTERPRETATION\b", span_text, re.M) or re.search(
        r"^INTERPRETATION=", span_text, re.M
    ):
        classes_found.append("INTERPRETATION")
    if re.search(r"^#{1,6} HYPOTHESIS\b", span_text, re.M) or re.search(
        r"^HYPOTHESIS=", span_text, re.M
    ):
        classes_found.append("HYPOTHESIS")
    if re.search(r"^#{1,6} .*NAVIGATION", span_text, re.M) or "NAVIGATION_ONLY" in span_text:
        classes_found.append("NAVIGATION")
    if "ADJUDICATED_CONCLUSION" in span_text or re.search(r"^VERDICT=", span_text, re.M):
        classes_found.append("ADJUDICATION")
    if "OPEN_OR_CONFLICTED" in span_text or "THIS_PERSIST_DOCUMENTS_A_CANONICAL_CONTROL_POINTER_CONFLICT=true" in span_text:
        classes_found.append("OPEN_OR_CONFLICTED")
    if re.search(r"^#{1,6} .*HYPOTHESIS", span_text, re.M):
        if "HYPOTHESIS" not in classes_found:
            classes_found.append("HYPOTHESIS")
    if len(set(classes_found)) >= 2:
        rec.record_type = "AMBIGUOUS_MIXED_SPAN"
        rec.unresolved_ambiguity = True
        rec.ambiguity_note = "Multiple epistemic class markers in one atomic span without inner BEGIN/END split; not silently partitioned."
        rec.classification_method = "STRUCTURAL"
        rec.parser_confidence = "UNKNOWN"


def classify_container(rec: Rec, first_line: str, span_text: str) -> None:
    rec.classification_method = "STRUCTURAL"
    rec.parser_confidence = "STRUCTURAL"
    rec.authority_class = "NONE"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    rec.track_affiliation = "ABSENT"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    rec.sui_affiliation = "ABSENT"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    rec.class_affiliation = "ABSENT"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    rec.overlap_class = "NESTING_PARENT_CHILD"
    rec.verbatim_raw = False
    rec.curated_adjudicated = False
    rec.adjudication_status = "NOT_STATED"
    rec.epistemic_class = "UNKNOWN"
    rec.historical_current_unknown = "UNKNOWN"
    rec.original_heading = first_line if first_line.startswith("#") else None
    if rec.container_kind == "L1":
        if rec.source_line_start == 1:
            rec.record_type = "OUTER_PERSISTENCE_HEADER"
            rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"
        elif is_continuation_h1(first_line) or is_header_h1(first_line):
            rec.record_type = "CHAT_PASS_CONTINUATION"
        else:
            rec.record_type = "UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN"
    elif rec.container_kind == "PASS":
        rec.record_type = "PASS_SECTION"
    elif rec.container_kind == "SRC":
        rec.record_type = "SRC_OBSERVATION_BLOCK"
        rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"
        rec.alias_ids = [f"SRC-{rec.container_id}"]
    elif rec.container_kind == "PRESERVED":
        rec.record_type = "PRESERVED_REPORT_WRAPPER"
        rec.alias_ids = [rec.container_id]
    elif rec.container_kind == "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT":
        rec.record_type = "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT"
        rec.classification_method = "EXPLICIT"
        rec.parser_confidence = "EXPLICIT"
        rec.alias_ids = [rec.container_id]
        if rec.container_id == "LOSSLESS_STRUCTURE_MODEL_REPORT_2026-08-23T155800Z":
            rec.record_type = "EMBEDDED_PRIOR_SPEC"
            rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"
    elif rec.container_kind == "FORENSIC_RECORD":
        rec.record_type = "FORENSIC_RECORD"
        rec.classification_method = "EXPLICIT"
        rec.parser_confidence = "EXPLICIT"
        rec.alias_ids = [rec.container_id]
        if "FORENSIC_RECORD_TYPE=READ_ONLY_ADJUDICATION_PERSIST" in span_text:
            rec.record_type = "ADJUDICATION_PERSIST"
            rec.curated_adjudicated = True
            rec.classification_method = "EXPLICIT"
            rec.parser_confidence = "EXPLICIT"
            vm = re.search(r"^VERDICT=([^\n]+)$", span_text, re.M)
            if vm:
                rec.adjudication_status = vm.group(1)
        if rec.container_id.startswith("LOSSLESS_STRUCTURE_MODEL_REPORT_PRESERVATION_"):
            rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"
    else:
        rec.record_type = "UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN"


def mark_verbatim_bodies(records: list[Rec], pairs: list[tuple[Event, Event]], starts: list[int], n_lines: int) -> None:
    for begin, end in pairs:
        if begin.begin_kind != "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT":
            continue
        b0, _ = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, begin.line + 1, begin.line + 1)
        if end.line <= begin.line + 1:
            continue
        _, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, end.line - 1, end.line - 1)
        # body is lines (begin.line+1) .. (end.line-1) inclusive
        body_start, body_end = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, begin.line + 1, end.line - 1)
        for rec in records:
            if rec.span_role != "ATOMIC":
                continue
            if rec.source_byte_start >= body_start and rec.source_byte_end <= body_end:
                rec.verbatim_raw = True
                rec.classification_method = "EXPLICIT"
                rec.parser_confidence = "EXPLICIT"
                if rec.record_type == "UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN":
                    rec.record_type = "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT"
                if begin.begin_id == "LOSSLESS_STRUCTURE_MODEL_REPORT_2026-08-23T155800Z":
                    rec.record_type = "EMBEDDED_PRIOR_SPEC"
                    rec.historical_current_unknown = "HISTORICAL"


def attach_parents(records: list[Rec]) -> None:
    containers = [r for r in records if r.span_role == "CONTAINER"]
    for rec in records:
        best: Rec | None = None
        best_size = None
        for c in containers:
            if c is rec:
                continue
            if c.source_byte_start <= rec.source_byte_start and c.source_byte_end >= rec.source_byte_end:
                size = c.source_byte_end - c.source_byte_start
                rec_size = rec.source_byte_end - rec.source_byte_start
                if size <= rec_size:
                    continue
                if best is None or size < best_size or (
                    size == best_size and c.source_byte_start > best.source_byte_start
                ):
                    best = c
                    best_size = size
        rec.parent = best
        if best is not None:
            best.children.append(rec)


def assign_seq_and_ids(records: list[Rec], data: bytes) -> None:
    tops = [r for r in records if r.parent is None]
    tops.sort(
        key=lambda r: (
            r.source_byte_start,
            0 if r.span_role == "CONTAINER" else 1,
            r.source_byte_end,
        )
    )
    seq = 0

    def walk(node: Rec) -> None:
        nonlocal seq
        node.seq_index = seq
        seq += 1
        span = data[node.source_byte_start : node.source_byte_end]
        node.raw_span_sha256 = sha256_bytes(span)
        node.record_id = f"rec:{node.seq_index:08d}:{node.raw_span_sha256[:16]}"
        if node.span_role == "ATOMIC":
            node.span_b64 = base64.b64encode(span).decode("ascii")
        node.children.sort(
            key=lambda r: (
                r.source_byte_start,
                0 if r.span_role == "CONTAINER" else 1,
                r.source_byte_end,
            )
        )
        for ch in node.children:
            walk(ch)

    for t in tops:
        walk(t)
    if any(r.seq_index < 0 for r in records):
        raise SystemExit("HARD_STOP_SEQ_INDEX_UNASSIGNED")

def build_records(data: bytes, lines: list[str], starts: list[int]) -> tuple[list[Rec], dict[str, Any]]:
    n_lines = len(lines)
    events, scan_counts, fence5_lines = scan_events(lines)
    pairs, unbal_notes = pair_begin_end(events)
    unbal_lines: set[int] = set()
    for note in unbal_notes:
        m = re.search(r"line=(\d+)", note)
        if m:
            unbal_lines.add(int(m.group(1)))

    cut_lines: set[int] = {1, n_lines + 1}
    for ev in events:
        cut_lines.add(ev.line)
        if ev.line + 1 <= n_lines + 1:
            cut_lines.add(ev.line + 1)
    cuts = sorted(cut_lines)

    records: list[Rec] = []
    unexpected_atomic = 0
    for a, b in zip(cuts, cuts[1:]):
        if a >= b:
            continue
        b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, a, b - 1)
        if b0 >= b1:
            continue
        ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
        rec = Rec(
            source_byte_start=b0,
            source_byte_end=b1,
            source_line_start=ls,
            source_line_end=le,
            span_role="ATOMIC",
            record_type="UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN",
            overlap_class="NONE",
        )
        span_text = data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8")
        first_line = lines[ls - 1]
        classify_atomic(rec, span_text, first_line, unbal_lines)
        rec.owner_go_raw = extract_owner_go(span_text)
        records.append(rec)

    # containers
    l1_events = [e for e in events if e.kind == "L1"]
    for i, ev in enumerate(l1_events):
        end_line = (l1_events[i + 1].line - 1) if i + 1 < len(l1_events) else n_lines
        b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, ev.line, end_line)
        ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
        rec = Rec(
            source_byte_start=b0,
            source_byte_end=b1,
            source_line_start=ls,
            source_line_end=le,
            span_role="CONTAINER",
            record_type="UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN",
            overlap_class="NESTING_PARENT_CHILD",
            container_kind="L1",
            container_id=l1_norm(ev.raw),
        )
        classify_container(rec, ev.raw, data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
        rec.owner_go_raw = extract_owner_go(data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
        records.append(rec)

    for ev in events:
        if ev.kind == "PASS":
            nxt = next_event_line(events, ev.line, {"PASS", "SRC", "PRESERVED", "BEGIN", "L1"})
            end_line = (nxt - 1) if nxt else n_lines
            b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, ev.line, end_line)
            ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
            rec = Rec(
                source_byte_start=b0,
                source_byte_end=b1,
                source_line_start=ls,
                source_line_end=le,
                span_role="CONTAINER",
                record_type="PASS_SECTION",
                overlap_class="NESTING_PARENT_CHILD",
                container_kind="PASS",
            )
            classify_container(rec, ev.raw, data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
            rec.owner_go_raw = extract_owner_go(data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
            records.append(rec)
        elif ev.kind == "SRC":
            nxt = next_event_line(events, ev.line, {"SRC", "BEGIN", "END", "L1"})
            end_line = (nxt - 1) if nxt else n_lines
            b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, ev.line, end_line)
            ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
            rec = Rec(
                source_byte_start=b0,
                source_byte_end=b1,
                source_line_start=ls,
                source_line_end=le,
                span_role="CONTAINER",
                record_type="SRC_OBSERVATION_BLOCK",
                overlap_class="NESTING_PARENT_CHILD",
                container_kind="SRC",
                container_id=ev.begin_id,
            )
            classify_container(rec, ev.raw, data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
            records.append(rec)
        elif ev.kind == "PRESERVED":
            nxt_p = next_event_line(events, ev.line, {"PRESERVED", "L1"})
            nxt_f = next_event_line(events, ev.line, {"BEGIN"}, {"FORENSIC_RECORD"})
            candidates = [x for x in (nxt_p, nxt_f) if x is not None]
            nxt = min(candidates) if candidates else None
            end_line = (nxt - 1) if nxt else n_lines
            b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, ev.line, end_line)
            ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
            rec = Rec(
                source_byte_start=b0,
                source_byte_end=b1,
                source_line_start=ls,
                source_line_end=le,
                span_role="CONTAINER",
                record_type="PRESERVED_REPORT_WRAPPER",
                overlap_class="NESTING_PARENT_CHILD",
                container_kind="PRESERVED",
                container_id=ev.begin_id,
            )
            classify_container(rec, ev.raw, data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
            rec.owner_go_raw = extract_owner_go(data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
            records.append(rec)

    for begin, end in pairs:
        b0, b1 = line_span_to_bytes(starts, n_lines, begin.line, end.line)
        ls, le = bytes_to_lines(starts, n_lines, b0, b1)
        rec = Rec(
            source_byte_start=b0,
            source_byte_end=b1,
            source_line_start=ls,
            source_line_end=le,
            span_role="CONTAINER",
            record_type="UNCLASSIFIED_SPAN",
            overlap_class="NESTING_PARENT_CHILD",
            container_kind=begin.begin_kind,
            container_id=begin.begin_id,
        )
        classify_container(rec, begin.raw, data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
        rec.owner_go_raw = extract_owner_go(data[b0:b1].decode("utf-8"))
        records.append(rec)

    # atomic overlap check
    atomics = sorted(
        [r for r in records if r.span_role == "ATOMIC"],
        key=lambda r: r.source_byte_start,
    )
    prev_end = 0
    gaps = 0
    overlaps = 0
    for a in atomics:
        if a.source_byte_start > prev_end:
            gaps += 1
        if a.source_byte_start < prev_end:
            overlaps += 1
            a.overlap_class = "UNEXPECTED"
            unexpected_atomic += 1
        prev_end = max(prev_end, a.source_byte_end)
    if atomics and atomics[0].source_byte_start != 0:
        gaps += 1
    if prev_end != EXPECTED_SIZE:
        gaps += 1

    attach_parents(records)
    mark_verbatim_bodies(records, pairs, starts, n_lines)
    assign_seq_and_ids(records, data)

    meta = {
        "scan_counts": scan_counts,
        "fence5_lines": fence5_lines,
        "unbalanced_notes": unbal_notes,
        "atomic_gap_count": gaps,
        "atomic_overlap_count": overlaps,
        "unexpected_atomic_overlap": unexpected_atomic,
        "begin_end_pairs": len(pairs),
        "event_count": len(events),
    }
    return records, meta


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    if path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"HARD_STOP_REFUSING_OVERWRITE_{path.name}")
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        for row in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))
            f.write("\n")
    tmp.replace(path)


def atomic_partition_ok(records: list[Rec]) -> tuple[bool, int, int]:
    atomics = sorted(
        [r for r in records if r.span_role == "ATOMIC"],
        key=lambda r: (r.source_byte_start, r.source_byte_end),
    )
    gaps = overlaps = 0
    prev = 0
    for a in atomics:
        if a.source_byte_start > prev:
            gaps += 1
        if a.source_byte_start < prev:
            overlaps += 1
        prev = max(prev, a.source_byte_end)
    if not atomics or atomics[0].source_byte_start != 0:
        gaps += 1
    if prev != EXPECTED_SIZE:
        gaps += 1
    return gaps == 0 and overlaps == 0, gaps, overlaps


def reconstruct(records: list[Rec], data: bytes) -> bytes:
    atomics = [r for r in records if r.span_role == "ATOMIC"]
    atomics.sort(key=lambda r: r.seq_index)
    parts = []
    for r in atomics:
        if r.span_b64:
            parts.append(base64.b64decode(r.span_b64))
        else:
            parts.append(data[r.source_byte_start : r.source_byte_end])
    return b"".join(parts)


def count_file_markers(data: bytes) -> dict[str, int]:
    text = data.decode("utf-8")
    lines = text.split("\n")
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines = lines[:-1]
    fence_stack: list[int] = []
    c = {k: 0 for k in MARKER_COUNTS}
    c["FIVE_BACKTICK_LINE_COUNT"] = 0
    for line in lines:
        n = fence_len_at_start(line)
        in_fence = bool(fence_stack)
        if n >= 3:
            if n == 5:
                c["FIVE_BACKTICK_LINE_COUNT"] += 1
            if fence_stack and n == fence_stack[-1] and fence_rest_ok_for_close(line, n):
                fence_stack.pop()
                continue
            if not (fence_stack and n < fence_stack[-1]):
                fence_stack.append(n)
            continue
        if in_fence:
            continue
        if is_continuation_h1(line):
            c["CONTINUATION_H1_COUNT"] += 1
        if RE_SRC.match(line):
            c["SRC_HEADING_COUNT"] += 1
        m = RE_BEGIN.match(line)
        if m:
            if m.group(1) == "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT":
                c["VERBATIM_BEGIN_COUNT"] += 1
            elif m.group(1) == "FORENSIC_RECORD":
                c["FORENSIC_BEGIN_COUNT"] += 1
        m = RE_END.match(line)
        if m:
            if m.group(1) == "VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_REPORT":
                c["VERBATIM_END_COUNT"] += 1
            elif m.group(1) == "FORENSIC_RECORD":
                c["FORENSIC_END_COUNT"] += 1
    return c


def run_adversarial(records: list[Rec], data: bytes, recon: bytes, meta: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    tests: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    def add(name: str, status: str, note: str) -> None:
        tests.append({"id": name, "status": status, "note": note})

    hist_as_current = [
        r
        for r in records
        if r.historical_current_unknown == "CURRENT"
        or (r.historical_current_unknown == "HISTORICAL" and r.authority_class == "CANONICAL")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    ]
    add(
        "1_historical_to_current_leakage",
        "PASS" if not hist_as_current else "FAIL",
        "No record promoted HISTORICAL to CURRENT/canonical. Desktop locator remains source bytes only.",
    )

    cont = [
        r
        for r in records
        if r.span_role == "CONTAINER"
        and r.record_type == "CHAT_PASS_CONTINUATION"
        and is_continuation_h1(r.original_heading or "")
    ]
    add(
        "2_false_dedup",
        "PASS" if len(cont) == 70 else "FAIL",
        f"continuation_l1_containers={len(cont)} expected=70",
    )

    verdict_in_recon = b"VERDICT=PARTIALLY_PROVEN_WITH_OPEN_RESIDUAL" in recon
    adj = [r for r in records if r.record_type == "ADJUDICATION_PERSIST"]
    add(
        "3_raw_overwrites_adjudication",
        "PASS" if verdict_in_recon and adj else "FAIL",
        f"verdict_in_recon={verdict_in_recon} adjudication_containers={len(adj)}",
    )

    add(
        "4_adjudication_erases_raw",
        "PASS" if recon == data else "FAIL",
        "Atomic concat equals snapshot bytes.",
    )

    atomics = [r for r in records if r.span_role == "ATOMIC"]
    by_seq = sorted(atomics, key=lambda r: r.seq_index)
    by_byte = sorted(atomics, key=lambda r: r.source_byte_start)
    add(
        "5_file_order_loss",
        "PASS" if [r.record_id for r in by_seq] == [r.record_id for r in by_byte] else "FAIL",
        "Atomic seq_index order equals source_byte_start order.",
    )

    missing_byte = [r for r in records if r.source_byte_end <= r.source_byte_start]
    add(
        "6_byte_provenance_loss",
        "PASS" if not missing_byte and all(r.source_byte_end <= EXPECTED_SIZE for r in records) else "FAIL",
        "All records have in-bounds half-open byte ranges.",
    )

    bad_lines = [
        r
        for r in records
        if r.source_line_start < 1 or r.source_line_end > EXPECTED_LINES or r.source_line_start > r.source_line_end
    ]
    add(
        "7_line_provenance_loss",
        "PASS" if not bad_lines else "FAIL",
        "All records have 1-based inclusive line ranges in bounds.",
    )

    add(
        "8_five_backtick_parsing_error",
        "PASS"
        if meta["scan_counts"]["five_backtick"] == 26 and meta["scan_counts"]["fence_stack_end"] == 0
        else "FAIL",

    for r in rows:

            epistemic_class=r.get("epistemic_class", "UNKNOWN"),
